press_references.value: Plenful Unveils AI Suite to Automate Intake and Prior Authorization, Accelerating Patient Care and Slashing Admin Work by 75%

product_launches.description: Plenful announced its Intake Authorization Management Suite, an AI-driven platform that automates intake, benefits verification, prior authorization, and claim reconciliation for healthcare organizations. overview_description.description:
Plenful optimizes healthcare and pharmacy operations through intelligent workflow automation, data configuration and centralization, and machine learning. The company built a healthcare-focused AI automation platform to unburden staff, deliver meaningful financial and operational results, and drive more efficient patient care outcomes.

Plenful is located in San Francisco, California and is backed by leading healthcare and software investors..

about_short_description.short_description: Plenful is a no-code workflow automation and AI platform that optimizes healthcare's manual, administrative workflows.

product.name: Plenful AI Workflow Automation Platform
product.description: A no-code, AI-enabled platform for automating complex administrative workflows across pharmacy, infusion, specialty pharmacy, and healthcare organizations.

product.name: 340B Audit & Optimization
product.description: A 340B program auditing solution that evaluates eligible claims, applies organization-specific audit logic, and identifies missed savings and compliance issues.

product.name: 340B Referral Agent
product.description: An AI workflow for identifying and investigating referral-based 340B savings opportunities in unstructured electronic health record data.

product.name: Rebate Management
product.description: A 340B rebate administration solution that automates rebate reporting submissions and provides centralized monitoring of reconciliation activities.

product.name: MFP Intelligence
product.description: A Maximum Fair Price reconciliation solution that provides claim-level visibility and automates the tracking of expected and received pharmacy refunds.

product.name: BV & Prior Authorization
product.description: An AI-powered workflow for specialty pharmacies that automates benefits verification and prior authorization processing.
